review_description: The whole process was friendly, clear, efficient and professional.Would highly reccomend

I wanted a good price for upgrading our solar from 6.7kW to 9.9kW. I had many discussions with the supplier and eventually the price was acceptable as he was able to quote some superseded panels he had in stock.The installers were punctual, polite and worked longer than I expected to install 3.1kW of panels, I think they had a problem with the Enphase software!My only concern was that the installer did a roof penetration on our house to connect, when, as the panels were being installed on a separate carport, I assumed that the connection would be directly into the external wiring.However, I did not discuss this with the installer upfront and my assumption was obviously wrong!!

Since my  initial phone conversation with Danny I know I was in good hands.  Danny went over and above to provide a excellent system at a fantastic price.  Installation was super quick at a time that was convenient for us and our builder.
All interactions were positive and my initial questions were answered without any problems.

Salesman came around and described new installation in jargon understood by the customer. Pointed out deficiency in current system. Once quote was accepted was only a short time before date for installation. Finished in one day. Tidy finish. One problem sorted promptly.
Quoting process was goodThe installation was a big day, clean up after, all the staff were polite and friendlyOrganise the grid connection and with a grid over power issue
The service was excellent. Every person involved was very professional and very helpful with any questions we had.

Bree was excellent, clear, and direct, and she followed up efficiently. She answered questions patiently and honestly. The boys who did the installation were perfect. I'm really happy with the end result and with using it. I was really happy using Finn's solar quoting service and the recommended installers, it made the decisions easy.
Every thing from start to finish has been at the highest quality we are very happy.

Sale & quote process we could not be happier with as Bree is so happy to do as much as she can.  Wonderful person.Installation went extremely well & we found the workers to be really polite, tidy & turned up early for the installation.Customer service with the organisation of this has been exellent.Overall we are extremely happy and we are more than happy to recommend Greenhouse Solar to anyone.  A very good experience
Couldn’t be more happy with the product and customer service.Fantastic communication from office staff and tradesman who installed the system.Would highly recommend Greenhouse Solar and Electrical.

Thank you to Greenhouse Solar and Electrical for our solar system. Bree, Daniel and the team at Greenhouse Solar and Electrical made the process so easy - from the initial contact, through to personally meeting Bree to talk through our requirements and to receive her recommendations, the assistance with completion of paperwork and finally, the install. It was a seamless process, and we are so very happy with the service.The whole team was punctual in responding to our initial enquiry, and also any questions we had along the way.On instal day, the Greenhouse Solar & Electrical team arrived on time, undertook the instal (keeping us updated as they went), did a handover of the system to us on completion of the instal, and left our home neat and tidy like they found it.A great team of people to have worked with.

Install was polite and punctual. The team did a fantastic job, from back office to the guys on the roof.Answered all queries and we have the confidence to know that they will be there for us in our solar future.

Every aspect of dealing with greenhouse solar was above and beyond.When messaging them directly I didn't speak to a robot, I spoke to Bree who was so knowledgeable and lovely.On site the team was so friendly and their attention to detail was great. We worked together and came up with a better solution than originally planned. Danny was so patient walking me through seeing up the remote monitoring and answering my 100's of questions.Even my neighbours installed with greenhouse too!Couldn't recommend them higher for all of your solar requirements
Quoting process was good.Installation, to our eyes, was good.Customor service was excellent.They organised and helped grid connections .

Having moved from Melbourne to Wodonga it was a little difficult to find prompt installer in the area. Having done a lot of research for our house on Melbourne I knew how solar installation market can have pitfalls.On recommendation we touched base with Greensolar and Electrical. The quote was very competitive and what was just as important the Instalation was scheduled within the time frame we needed.Installation was seamless and without unexpected issues.We confidently recommend Greensolar and Electrical.Zdravka and Lazo.

Danny and his team did an absolutely amazing job for me on my home, I cant recommend them enough, they were reliable, professional and did the job in an amazingly quick time frame. They have done 2 other homes for me and I will continue to use Greenhouse on all of my projects from now on, as I said the Best on the Border.
Daniel was easy to deal with, always happy to answer our questions and knowledgeable, would deffinatly recommend
They did everything I did have to do a thing excellent service I say again excellent service highly recommend
110% recommend, prompt and very professional, the system is exactly what is required and recommended by the team, do yourself a favour and use these guys for you’re new install

Danny was one of the first suppliers we contacted and he stayed in contact with us for an extended period until the system was installed on Saturday (10Dec16). He was able to cut thru the hype that other suppliers told us and offered a range of options until we settled on 14*255W Hanover Deutsche panes and a 5 kw Zeversolar inverter.He arrived to install when he promised and the installation was done in a day and he departed leaving no evidence he was there, except a working solar system.
Dan was mentioned by you and was the only one that listened to my desires and provided promt feedback and pricing
